text:
maria_customer: Hey team — autopay failed for Acme invoice INV-7890 just now. Customer sees 'Card declined' in the UI. Our payments dashboard shows `decline_code=insufficient_funds` for attempt 1, but attempt 3 has `fraud_score=87` and `acs=challenge_required`. This is a PO customer; renewal blocked. Screenshot: https://acme.screenshots/INV-7890.png

autopay-bot: scheduled retry id=autopay_retry_2330001111 attempt=2 scheduled_at=2330001410

sophie_support: @maria_customer thanks — can you paste the provider transaction id + request_id and last4? Also which timezone the customer reported the failure in?

maria_customer: tx_id=pay_01H8XxZZZK0, request_id=req_8f7a2c, last4=3782, customer_acct=ACME_CORP_41, reported_time=2026-03-12T14:02:03Z (UTC)

liam_payments: quick triage from logs — gateway first two attempts returned `decline_code=insufficient_funds`. Third attempt triggered SCA (ACS) and the ACS challenge timed out. Pasting relevant snippet from payments logs:

```
[2026-03-12T14:01:58Z] payments.INFO charge.start tx=pay_01H8XxZZZK0 invoice=INV-7890 last4=3782 gateway_resp=insufficient_funds decline_code=insufficient_funds fraud_score=12
[2026-03-12T14:05:10Z] payments.INFO charge.retry tx=pay_01H8XxZZZK0 attempt=2 gateway_resp=insufficient_funds decline_code=insufficient_funds fraud_score=10
[2026-03-12T14:08:30Z] payments.INFO charge.retry tx=pay_01H8XxZZZK0 attempt=3 gateway_resp=acs_redirect acs_status=challenge_required fraud_score=87
[2026-03-12T14:09:45Z] payments.WARN acs.callback tx=pay_01H8XxZZZK0 acs_result=timeout
[2026-03-12T14:09:46Z] payments.ERROR charge.failed tx=pay_01H8XxZZZK0 final_decline=challenge_timeout decline_reason="ACS challenge timed out"
```

liam_payments: Repro curl (staging) — use `tok_test` for the card token and set headers as below. This will follow the same gateway path (EU routing):

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/invoices/pay \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_test_xxx" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"invoice_id":"INV-7890","card_token":"tok_test_3782","capture":true}'
```

sophie_support: Is this happening for just this customer or other PO customers too? Any correlation with billing country or acquirer?

liam_payments: So far isolated to this merchant in last 24h. Gateway routing: EU acquirer -> ACS provider X. The `fraud_score=87` on attempt 3 explains why ACS was required. ACS challenge timeout looks like user never completed the challenge in the 60s window (customer on phone said modal didn't load).

harry_eng: tagging to eng: @liam_payments / @ana_ops — two asks: (1) can we confirm whether ACS iframe is being blocked by CSP or adblock on the merchant UI path (customer said modal didn't load), and (2) check fallback policy: if ACS times out we currently surface decline to UI and do not retry with fallback when fraud_score > 80. Confirm if that's desired for PO customers.

ana_ops: I can reach out to Acme (CS) to confirm client environment. If they can provide console logs/screenshots of the modal failing to render that helps. Also we can temporarily release PO hold if they provide a new card.

liam_payments: Agreed with eng triage. Immediate actions: 1) Sophie please ask customer to try immediate manual pay via invoice link (we'll accept new card), 2) Ana to request console screenshot and network HAR of the failed ACS flow, 3) Payments to hold off auto-retries beyond the scheduled 3 attempts for now.

sophie_support: On it. Messaging customer now: offering manual card entry link + option to schedule assisted payment call. Will ask for console HAR and confirm if they have iframe blockers.

autopay-bot: retry_failed id=autopay_retry_2330001111 attempts=3 final_status=failed next_retry=None

harry_eng: From runtime perspective, notes for follow-up: - check ACS iframe loading errors in edge cases where CSP blocks `frame-src` to acs provider. - ensure our UX surfaces a clearer fallback message to merchant admin (explain challenge timeout & next steps). I'll open an ENG ticket with logs and include sample HAR if Acme provides one.

liam_payments: If we need a workaround today, payments can temporarily whitelist a one-off exception to allow fallback (skip ACS) for this invoice only, but only if Acme confirms card owner consent. That avoids force-failing renewals for PO customers who can provide a verified card.

ana_ops: I will hold the PO release until CS confirms consent. cc: @sophie_support for confirmation.

sophie_support: Customer replied — they tried in Chrome with an old extension; disabled extension and modal loaded once, manual payment succeeded. They want us to re-run autopay for this invoice and ensure renewal isn't blocked.

liam_payments: Great — since manual succeeded, we'll mark invoice PAID and clear the renewal hold. I'll also annotate the transaction with `mitigated_by_manual_payment` and close the autopay retry loop.

maria_customer: Thanks team — please add note on account and confirm renewal flag cleared.

sophie_support: Done. Notes added to ACME_CORP_41: "Autopay failed due to ACS modal blocked by browser extension; manual payment accepted 2026-03-12T14:25Z. Renewal hold released." :white_check_mark:

harry_eng: Follow-ups for next week: ENG ticket to improve ACS modal diagnostics + ensure fallback policy documented for PO customers. Assign to eng-runtime for 2d spike.

liam_payments: I'll update postmortem with bandwidth and suggest adding a small retry with user-visible prompt before final fail when acs_timeout occurs and fraud_score < 90.

sophie_support: Closing thread once ENG ticket created. Thanks everyone :raised_hands:
